name: ANSI manual fire alarm station plan symbol
summary: US-style plan symbol for a manual fire alarm pull station, commonly a square with an F, at each exit.
description: US plans mark manual pull stations with a square containing F or a pull-station shape, located within reach of each exit door. Single-action and double-action types are distinguished in the device schedule.

The plan is used to check that pull stations are within the required distance of each exit and at the required height. Protective covers may be specified where malicious activation is a risk. The symbol does not show the action type or cover.
distinction: The IEC manual call point is a break-glass or resettable push; the US pull station is operated by pulling a handle.

facts.label: Operation
facts.value: Pull handle, single or double action
